rain.plot.player.tell.main_plot.c_4.text: In the beginning of chaos, yin and yang were first divided, and primal energy permeated.
Beyond the void, stars were yet unplaced; within the underworld, water and fire lay hidden.
In the void, a faint light born is me. Before distinguishing dawn from dusk, first split the primordial chaos.
Before distinguishing dawn from dusk, first split the primordial chaos.
The turbid descends, the clear ascends, blending and churning; galaxies spin forth from the palm.
Looking back, the silent primeval passes; the azure lotus falls deep into shadow.
At the glance back, lies the path of creation, traces of the fire of tribulation.

jei.rain.world_interaction.mangrove_slab: Right-click mangrove planks with any axe in the main hand: destroys the planks, drops 2 mangrove slabs and costs 2 axe durability.
jei.rain.world_interaction.oak_slabs: Right-click oak planks with any axe in the main hand: destroys the planks, drops 2 oak slabs and costs 2 axe durability.
jei.rain.world_interaction.cobblestone: Right-click the Ultimate Crafting Table with the staff in the main hand: drops 8 cobblestone per click. The table and staff remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.bottle_void: Use a glass bottle in the Overworld. The block directly below the player must be air or void air at block Y <= -64. Consumes 1 bottle and gives 1 Bottle of Void. Use the item in the air; the empty block slot means no target block.
jei.rain.world_interaction.bedrock: Right-click bedrock with the staff in the main hand: destroys the target block and drops 1 bedrock. The staff remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.skeleton_skul: Left-click a bone block with the staff in the main hand: replaces the block with a placed skeleton skull. The staff remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.villager: Right-click grass with a Summon Focus in the main hand and Dye Essence in the off hand. Consumes 1 of each, summons a villager above the block and replaces the grass with an Allthemodium Block. No villager item or spawn egg is given.
jei.rain.world_interaction.tallow: Sneak and right-click in the air with a Butcher Knife in the main hand: gives 1 Tallow, deals 6 damage (3 hearts) and clears damage invulnerability frames. The knife remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.black_hole: Right-click a Black Hole Block with the staff in the main hand: destroys the target and drops 1 Black Hole Block. The staff remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.aura: Right-click the Aura Generator with Nature Essence in the main hand: consumes 1 essence and stores 1,000 Aura in the local aura chunk. No item output.
jei.rain.world_interaction.cow: Right-click an Allthemodium Block with a villager item in the main hand and the staff in the off hand: consumes 1 villager, removes the target block and summons a cow above it. The staff remains; no cow spawn egg is given.
jei.rain.world_interaction.steel_seeds: Right-click a Black Hole Block with Iron Seeds in the main hand and the staff in the off hand: consumes 1 Iron Seeds and gives 1 Steel Seeds. The block and staff remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.whirlisprig: Right-click grass with a Summon Focus in the main hand and the staff in the off hand: consumes 1 focus and gives a Whirlisprig Data Model. The grass and staff remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.mimic: Sneak-right-click a chest with a Blank Data Model in the main hand and the staff in the off hand: consumes 1 blank model and gives a Mimic Data Model. The chest and staff remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.slime: Sneak-right-click a Pink Slime Block with a Blank Data Model in the main hand and the staff in the off hand: consumes 1 blank model and gives a Slime Data Model. The block and staff remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.fluid_process: Right-click a barrier with the staff in the main hand: destroys the barrier and drops a Custom Machine item bound to fluid_processing. The staff remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.ice_essence: Left-click a Conversion Catalyst with a snow block in the main hand: the KubeJS event always drops 1 Ice Essence and keeps the catalyst. A separate Lychee recipe consumes the snow block and has a 50% chance to drop another Ice Essence; see its recipe page.
jei.rain.world_interaction.chain_command: Right-click a command block with a Debug Stick in the main hand: replaces it with a chain command block. The stick remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.command_block: Right-click a chain command block with a Debug Stick in the main hand: replaces it with a command block. The stick remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.fire: Right-click any block while holding the Fire item. Ordinary air is required above the target; consumes 1 Fire item and places fire above it. Uses the main hand first, otherwise the off hand.
jei.rain.world_interaction.command_block: Right-click a command block with a Blank Data Model in the main hand and a minecart in the off hand. Every attempt consumes 1 minecart. There is a 1% chance to give a Command Block Minecart Data Model; only success consumes the blank model. The block remains.
jei.rain.world_interaction.debug_stick: Right-click a command block with an Ancient Stick in the main hand: consumes 1 stick and gives 1 Debug Stick. Independently has a 10% chance to remove the command block.
jei.rain.world_interaction.time_in_a_bot: Sneak-right-click a command block with Time in a Bottle in the main hand. Adds 7,200,000 ticks (100 hours) to the original stored value and sets total to the same new value. Replaces the bottle and removes the command block. The output icon represents the bottle; its stored time depends on the input.
jei.rain.world_interaction.summon_model: Right-click a command block with a bound Data Model in the main hand and a Summon Focus in the off hand. Consumes 1 of each and summons the entity recorded by that model above the block. The entity depends on the model data; no spawn egg is given.
jei.rain.world_interaction.remove_radiat: Right-click a command block with Solidified Radiation in the main hand and the staff in the off hand. Consumes 1 Solidified Radiation and removes all Mekanism radiation after a delay. The block and staff remain; no item output.
jei.rain.world_interaction.repeating_com: Build a single-layer 5x5 structure and right-click the central chain command block; it becomes a repeating command block after a delay. Rows: cabac / aadaa / bdrdb / aadaa / cabac. a=end stone, b=peridot block, c=command block, d=imperium ingot block, r=central chain command block. Consumes the 4 outer edge-center peridot blocks; other structure blocks remain.
jei.rain.world_interaction.collect_barri: Left-click the target block with an empty hand or any item: destroys it and drops 1 of the same block. No staff required.
jei.rain.world_interaction.collect_comma: Left-click the target block with an empty hand or any item: destroys it and drops 1 of the same block. No staff required.
jei.rain.world_interaction.collect_chain: Left-click the target block with an empty hand or any item: destroys it and drops 1 of the same block. No staff required.
jei.rain.world_interaction.collect_repea: Left-click the target block with an empty hand or any item: destroys it and drops 1 of the same block. No staff required.
jei.rain.world_interaction.place_command: Right-click any block with the indicated command block in the main hand. Ordinary air is required above the target; consumes 1 held block and places it above the target.
jei.rain.world_interaction.place_chain_c: Right-click any block with the indicated command block in the main hand. Ordinary air is required above the target; consumes 1 held block and places it above the target.
jei.rain.world_interaction.place_repeati: Right-click any block with the indicated command block in the main hand. Ordinary air is required above the target; consumes 1 held block and places it above the target.
jei.rain.world_interaction.fishing_cod: When reeling in a normal fishing catch, this Data Model has an independent 25% chance to be added to the fishing loot. This is fishing loot, not crafting by right-clicking a water block. No extra materials are consumed.
jei.rain.world_interaction.fishing_squid: When reeling in a normal fishing catch, this Data Model has an independent 25% chance to be added to the fishing loot. This is fishing loot, not crafting by right-clicking a water block. No extra materials are consumed.
